title: Round 2 🔥 Mexico vs Japan vs UK… Who Goes to the Semi-Final? Marble Race Heat 2/3
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Round 2 · Heat 2/3: 32 countries race through 3 stages — only 16 survive and go to The Semi-Finals.

Countries in this heat: Afghanistan, Australia, Bangladesh, Barbados, Burkina Faso, Cape Verde, Comoros, DR Congo, Gabon, Hungary, Iran, Iraq, Japan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Micronesia, New Zealand, North Korea, Philippines, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Singapore, Slovakia, South Korea, Suriname, Tanzania, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom, Yemen, Zimbabwe.

Countries still in the game before this race: 80 of 193.
Next race: Round 2 · Heat 3/3. Grand Final: Nov 8.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. New races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
